name: Lactobacillus plantarum 299v
summary: Lactobacillus plantarum 299v (DSM 9843) is a Swedish probiotic strain with documented mucosal adhesion. Human trials in IBS show pain and bloating improvements vs placebo, including an n=214 RCT and a smaller n=40 RCT where 95% vs 15% improved, plus 12-week real-world data.
description: Canonical Lactobacillus plantarum 299v research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: IBS pain and bloating; gut mucosal adhesion; strain-specific probiotic effects

research_metadata.evidence_notes: RCT n=214 IBS 4wk (PMID 22912552); RCT n=40 IBS (PMID 11711768); real-world n=221 12wk (PMID 33556972). All PMIDs verified in-session.
